items.statement: Predictions are verified against FEM solutions of the same plane-stress model, not against physical measurements.
Only requests inside the ratified envelope dogbone-v1-strain-controlled-10-20-v1 are served; everything else is refused with a reason code.
The HOLDOUT budget was checked on a finite sample of cases; it is evidence, not a uniform error bound.

One compressible Neo-Hookean material (E = 760 MPa, nu = 0.23) in 2D finite-strain plane stress with 1 mm reference thickness, under displacement-controlled nominal axial strain from 10% to 20%, on the quarter model with two symmetry planes.
The served stress is constitutive: P_served is the plane-stress Neo-Hookean first Piola stress of the predicted deformation (ADR 0018). There is no independent stress head.
The peak QoI was verified against an L2-recovered P2 FEM stress at the fillet-root vertices; it is mesh- and recovery-dependent and not a certified physical maximum.
The DEVELOPMENT FEM-reference budget failed on two slices and was accepted by the decision owner (ADR 0021); HOLDOUT was judged with the unchanged rule and passed.

The confidence bound is the DEVELOPMENT-calibrated 90% quantile of the pointwise in-plane stress error given the equilibrium-residual indicator; its HOLDOUT coverage was 86.8%, below the nominal 90%, and indicators beyond the calibrated range are flagged.

paragraph: PI-GINOT performs numerical verification against finite element method (FEM) solutions. That is not experimental validation, and it does not show that predictions agree with measurements from physical specimens. Verification for a bundle establishes nothing about geometries outside that bundle's declared input envelope. Inputs outside the envelope must not be treated as covered by the bundle's results. Finite verification sampling is evidence about the evaluated cases, not a mathematical proof of a uniform error bound over every admissible input.
